reviews.text: My elderly dog was attacked today, and I called Hills for an emergency appointment whilst I was driving to them. Patrick was assigned to me and he was nothing short of brilliant!! Kind, caring, knowledgeable, informative. Professional! And didn’t take advantage with the costs! Highly recommend

This is a great Vet practice- my cat has been with them for a couple of years. In my view, they don’t over treat or overcharge, and offer common sense advice. My cat seems to really like Beth, who is the Vet who last treated her!  They are also responsive to calls and have good availability of appointments in my experience.
Love this vets - lovely caring staff and great atmosphere. My nervous rescue cat always feels relaxed which is amazing.

I had absolutely the worst ever experience with this veterinary practice today.

I left with the overwhelming impression that this practice is now far more interested in extracting as much money as possible from its clients than in treating them and their animals fairly, honestly and professionally.

The estimate I was given was already higher than I had expected, and then the final bill was even higher. What made the situation considerably worse was that the agreements and understanding we had previously reached were simply dismissed when it came time to honour them. Instead of acknowledging what had been agreed and trying to find a fair solution, I felt that the vet was obviously focused on extracting even more money from me rather than treating me and my cat fairly and professionally.

The attitude of the nurse made an already upsetting situation even worse. I found her manner unnecessarily rude and completely lacking in the empathy and professionalism I would expect from someone dealing with a worried pet owner.

Even more upsetting was the way I was spoken to about what had happened with my cat. Instead of showing compassion and trying to resolve the situation constructively, I felt that I was being guilt-tripped and made to feel responsible. Using an owner’s concern and love for their animal to make them feel guilty — is completely unacceptable to me.

When people bring a beloved pet to a vet, they are already in a vulnerable and stressful position. They should be able to trust that the professionals treating their animal will communicate transparently, honour what has been agreed, provide clear and reasonable estimates, and approach the situation with compassion rather than making the owner feel pressured or guilty.

What makes this particularly sad is that my previous experiences with this practice were much better. Unfortunately, the level of service now seems to be clearly deteriorating, and I am genuinely sad to see this happening to a practice that I previously trusted and respected.

I am extremely disappointed and angry about how I was treated today. After this experience, my trust in this practice has been seriously damaged. I would strongly advise other pet owners to get every agreement, estimate and commitment in writing before proceeding with treatment.

The only vet I trust there is Rowan Barnes. He is caring and passionate about his work.
Best vet , but very hard to speak to them over the telephone.

Lovely vets who looked after our dog really well but the billing is a bit of a let down.
Received a very harsh note saying they were going to send bailiffs to collect on a bill which  we had not been told about (first and last notice was by text). Asked reception about it as we’ve never had a problem paying before and they said they’ve been short staffed on the admin side which is why we weren’t contacted so do check what you owe/will owe before you leave the practice. Up until this, would have given the place 5 stars.

I am writing to express my disappointment following my recent appointment.

I booked the appointment through the app several days in advance and included a detailed explanation of the issue. I explained that my dog was suffering, that she had had her anal glands emptied a few months ago but had not improved, and that she had also been prescribed anti-allergy medication which had not helped. I therefore wanted her to be seen and properly checked by a vet.

When I arrived, I was told that the appointment was only with a nurse for anal gland emptying, and that no vet was available. I was then told, in a very dismissive and arrogant tone, that this was my mistake because I had selected “anal glands” on the app. When I explained that I had also left a clear description of the problem, I was told that this had been seen that morning and that you had intended to call me to rearrange, but had not done so.

I booked the earliest appointment I could find because my dog was clearly uncomfortable and suffering. To then arrive and be told that she could not be seen, with no apology and no attempt to help or even briefly assess her, was extremely disappointing. There appeared to be very little concern shown for her wellbeing.

The way the situation was handled was poor, and the attitude from the lady at the desk was unacceptable. I left feeling that neither my dog’s condition nor my concerns were taken seriously.

I try to support independent local businesses, especially veterinary practices, so it is very disappointing to have had an experience that felt as uncaring as some of the larger corporate providers.

Based on this experience, I will not be returning.
